_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to private/personal_profile.json (gitignored) and fill in your real values. Never commit the real file. date_of_birth: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. roth_contribution_basis: total dollars of direct Roth contributions (verify against Form 8606, Form 5498 box 10, or Fidelity). Converted amounts and their 5-year clocks are not modeled. ordinary_income: expected ordinary income for the tax year — sizes the 0% long-term-cap-gains budget on the Asset Location page, which is (0%-bracket ceiling minus ordinary income). Omit it or leave it at 0 and that budget is treated as exhausted rather than guessed at, since assuming room that is not there would mean realizing gains you expected to be untaxed. tax_residence: the state and local jurisdictions that tax your income, one entry each, for the Liquidity page's tax costs. ordinary_rate and gains_rate are fractions (0.05, not 5) read off each jurisdiction's own published rate table at your bracket; source names that table and source_date its date. An entry without a source or date is refused, and with no tax_residence the page includes no state or local tax and says so. federal_tax: the federal rates the Liquidity and Asset Location pages price with, and Tax Lots' harvest estimate. ordinary_rate is your federal marginal bracket and gains_rate your long-term capital-gains rate, both fractions (0.12, not 12), read off the IRS's inflation-adjustment revenue procedure for the tax year; niit.applies is true when your modified AGI is above the net investment income tax threshold in the Instructions for Form 8960. Each entry names its tax_year, the IRS source it was read from and that source's date, and all three must name the same tax year. Without federal_tax the two pages price nothing and Tax Lots leaves its estimate unpriced, and each says so. The rates below are null on purpose: fill them in. withheld_names: the names committed text must never carry. names lists every employer and workplace-plan provider, current or former, each as {name, kind}; employer_stock_tickers lists tickers committed text must never tie to an employer. account_labels (keyed by account pseudonym) and security_names (keyed by ticker) are the real labels the personal book shows where the committed seeds carry neutral ones; the personal bootstrap writes them into tracker.db. tests/test_no_employer_names.py reads these in personal mode and fails on any tracked file that holds one of the names.

jurisdictions.name: Your state
jurisdictions.source: the published rate table the rate is read from

ordinary_rate.source: the IRS revenue procedure and table the bracket is read from

gains_rate.source: the IRS revenue procedure and section the gains breakpoints are read from

niit.source: Instructions for Form 8960, the threshold for your filing status
